Nikolai once handled a critical system outage during a Black Friday sale. When VirtueMart’s platform crashed under unprecedented traffic, he swiftly deployed a Kubernetes-based autoscaling solution, rerouted traffic via load balancers, and restored uptime within 45 minutes. His calm under pressure and technical precision prevented potential revenue loss and earned him the team’s respect.  

Nikolai is a Staff Platform Engineer at VirtueMart, where he designs scalable infrastructure for e-commerce systems. He collaborates closely with dev teams to automate workflows and optimize cloud resources. His approach balances technical rigor with pragmatic problem-solving, often prioritizing reliability over flashy features.  

Beyond technical skills, Nikolai excels in system resilience and cost efficiency. He redesigned VirtueMart’s AWS architecture using Terraform, reducing monthly cloud costs by 22% while improving deployment reliability. His GitHub Actions pipelines cut manual testing cycles by half, and his Linux admin expertise ensures servers run smoothly under stress. He also maintains Prometheus/Grafana dashboards that proactively alert teams to potential bottlenecks.  

Nikolai is a dependable, thoughtful engineer who consistently delivers under pressure. His ability to merge technical depth with business impact makes him a rare asset. I wholeheartedly recommend him for any role requiring both innovation and operational excellence.
